headlines.title: August jobs report could show another weak month for hiring
headlines.description: The August jobs report is expected to show a continuation of this summer’s soft hiring numbers, just one month after the labor market contracted by 23,000 jobs.

headlines.title: Oil touches $97 per barrel as diesel prices surge to highest level this year
headlines.description: The nationwide average price for diesel fuel rose to $5.78 per gallon, up 9 cents overnight.

headlines.title: Gas cost calculator: How much have higher gas prices cost you?
headlines.description: Americans have spent an estimated $40 billion more in gas since the Iran war started. According to an NBC News analysis, drivers who fill up twice a month paid anywhere from $20 to $300 more for gas.

headlines.title: Fox News parts ways with Maria Bartiromo
headlines.description: Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo, a vocal defender of President Donald Trump who hosted several financial news shows.

headlines.title: How the Iran War is Driving Up Everyday American Costs
headlines.description: As the war between the United States and Iran ramps up again, it continues to have a major impact on American's wallets with rising oil prices, interest rates and more. NBC’s chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY to break down what it means for everyday expenses and global bond rates.

headlines.title: Social media is supercharging the decades-old collectible craze
headlines.description: Children of the 80s and 90s probably remember the frenzy to collect the latest fad toy of the year, but far from dying out in our digital age, collectibles are hotter, and more valuable, than ever. NBC News' Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: How to Shop Smarter During 2026 Labor Day Sales
headlines.description: Labor Day sales are right around the corner, so NBC’s chief business correspondent Christine Romans stops by TODAY to share the best items to shop, tips for snagging the best price, reveals which stores are offering the best deals, and more.

headlines.title: How Personal Finance is Changing for Younger Generations
headlines.description: From saving for retirement to talking openly about money, Yanely Espinal, Next Gen personal finance director of educational outreach, joins TODAY to share how to navigate personal finances in today’s world. Her tips include opening a high-yield savings account, reverse budgeting, diversifying income and more.

headlines.title: Probe finds Dianna Russini’s ties to Patriots coach to be ‘awkward’ and ‘uncomfortable’
headlines.description: The Athletic said it could not find any substantial evidence of journalistic wrongdoing by its former NFL insider and Mike Vrabel.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Gloria Steinem, fierce feminist trailblazer, dies at 92
headlines.description: A pioneering activist and journalist, Steinem was one of the women’s liberation movement’s most outspoken advocates.

headlines.title: Bill Simmons under review by Massachusetts authorities after admitting to proxy sports betting
headlines.description: Simmons, the founder of The Ringer, said Tuesday that it was a “lesson learned” after FanDuel voided his wagers.
